items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: This club was owned by a woman by the name of Ann Montgomery.

ctx.x: This club was owned by a woman by the name of Ann Montgomery. And he had a band in there, and we used to get there and they had this Round the Town broadcast, and whatever -- and we'd get to battling on that, you know. We had a half hour, so we'd stretch out.
Oh, on the air, a battle on the air?
